import datetime,difflib,hashlib,json,pathlib
B=pathlib.Path('/workspace/scratch/actual-source-regular-local-collar-construct');S=pathlib.Path('/workspace/Math-curvature-20261026/frontiers/source_derivative_gaussian_20261025/SourceActualRegularLocalCollar.lean')
old=S.read_text();new=old
for a,b in [["(ContinuousLinearMap.proj (0 : Fin 2)).comp Q","(ContinuousLinearMap.proj (0 : Fin 2) : Point2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp (Q : E2 →L[ℝ] Point2)"],["(ContinuousLinearMap.proj (1 : Fin 2)).comp Q","(ContinuousLinearMap.proj (1 : Fin 2) : Point2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp (Q : E2 →L[ℝ] Point2)"],["  simpa [fixtureXseam, fixture_seam_phase.2] using fixture_seam_phase.2","  simp [fixtureXseam, fixture_seam_phase.2]"],["    exact hp\n  ext i","    simpa [neg_div] using hp\n  ext i"],["    · simpa only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, neg_div, abs_neg] using hhalf","    · simpa [neg_div, abs_neg] using hhalf"],["(hpc ε hε).2.joinedIn hm hp","(hpc ε hε).2.joinedIn _ hm _ hp"],["ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply","zero_apply"]]:
 assert a in new,a;new=new.replace(a,b)
H=B/'history/production-fixtures-fix001';H.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False);orig=H/'SourceActualRegularLocalCollar.lean.ORIGINAL';orig.write_text(old);S.write_text(new)
p=B/'PRODUCTION_FIXTURES_FIX001_FULL.patch';p.write_text(''.join(difflib.unified_diff(old.splitlines(keepends=True),new.splitlines(keepends=True),fromfile='history/production-fixtures-fix001/SourceActualRegularLocalCollar.lean.ORIGINAL',tofile='SourceActualRegularLocalCollar.lean')))
cp=B/'FIRST_ID_CACHE.json';cache=json.loads(cp.read_text());prior=cache[str(S)];st=orig.stat();cache[str(orig)]={**prior,'path':str(orig),'marker':[st.st_size,st.st_mtime_ns],'origin':'Known exact prior source ID REUSED; no hash','copied_from':str(S)}
st=p.stat();cache[str(p)]={'path':str(p),'bytes':st.st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'marker':[st.st_size,st.st_mtime_ns],'first_observed_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'origin':'FIRST new actual full patch identity, once'};cp.write_text(json.dumps(cache,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'scope':'Only fixtures001 concrete CLM type/simp/coercion/JoinedIn/deprecation findings','full_patch':str(p)}))
